description.text: A 60-card Constructed Standard Deck released on 11 February 2010 and built around Darkness-type Pokémon, the first in the LEGEND series, led by Tyranitar with Houndoom as a Great Pokémon. It plays like a Darkness deck, getting in the opponent's way. Many of its cards are Pokémon from the Reviving Legends expansion with different artwork and attacks, which made it a good base for changing a deck. It has two holo cards and came with damage counters and markers, a coin, a half playmat and a how-to-play book.
